ios.desc:
Cloudflare Remote is a mobile control room for your Cloudflare account, built for people who need to fix things without waiting until they are back at a laptop.

Manage DNS, firewall rules, cache behaviour, tunnels, Workers, SSL and analytics from your iPhone, in a fast native interface.

DNS & DOMAINS
• Manage records of every common type (A, AAAA, CNAME, MX, TXT, NS, SRV, PTR)
• Create, edit and delete records instantly, with the proxy toggle on each one
• Export a whole zone as a BIND file, or import one
• DNSSEC status and configuration
• Multi-account support with fast switching

ANALYTICS
• Requests, bandwidth, unique visitors and threats
• Cache hit ratio, cached against uncached traffic
• HTTP status distribution and top countries
• 24 hours, 7 days or 30 days

SECURITY
• Firewall rules with Cloudflare's own expression language
• WAF managed rulesets
• IP access rules by IP, CIDR, country or ASN
• Rate limiting rules
• Live security events, with the rule that caught each request
• Security level, up to Under Attack mode
• SSL/TLS mode, certificates and minimum TLS version

PERFORMANCE & RULES
• Cache rules and transform rules
• Page rules and redirect rules
• Cache purge, everything or by URL
• Development mode
• Browser cache TTL, Brotli, HTTP/2, HTTP/3, IPv6, WebSockets, Always Online

TUNNELS & ZERO TRUST
• Cloudflare Tunnel health, active connections and their locations
• Public hostnames you can add and edit in place
• Protect any hostname with Zero Trust Access, and decide who may reach it

DEVELOPERS
• Workers & Pages deployments, with one-tap rollback and retry
• Workers scripts and the routes bound to each domain
• R2 buckets

AVAILABILITY
• Load balancers with their origin pools
• Health checks

EMAIL ROUTING
• Forward addresses on your domain to a personal inbox
• Manage routing rules and destinations

AUDIT
• See who changed what on the account, and when

PRIVACY & SECURITY
• Your API key or token is kept in the device Keychain, pinned to that device, so it is excluded from iCloud and iTunes backups
• It is sent to nobody but Cloudflare's own API. There is no server behind this app to send it to
• Optional Face ID, Touch ID or passcode lock in front of the app
• Sign in with a scoped API Token and grant only the permissions you choose
• No analytics SDK, no advertising SDK, no tracking, no usage data collected

SUBSCRIPTIONS
Premium unlocks every domain on your account, plus tunnels, Access, Workers & Pages, R2, cache rules, transform r
